messages:
maria: FYI: noticed a few tenants with doubled token counts after soft v2 rollout. Looks like pinning + autoswitch jitter.

tomas: example tenant? repro?

maria: tenant=acme-marketing. short calls pinned to v1, tiny header flip -> autoswitch to v2 -> console shows both variants billed.

sophie: pin TTL=24h and handshake debounce=5m, so mid-session flips are possible.

jason: current billing = served-variant; that double-counts on flips.

eng-platform-bot: alert: routing.pin-debounce anomalies +14% 6h

tomas: proposal: (1) tenant "escape hatch" button to force unpin; (2) transient pin-grace in proxy (default 2m) to avoid double attribution.

sophie: Console: stacked series (pinned / fallback / overlap) + audit events. Also add "simulate-unpin" preview for support.

jason: billing default should conservatively charge stable (pre-pin) variant unless unpin-forced audit exists. I'll loop in finance/compliance.

tomas: telemetry: route.pin.requested, .forced, .grace_enter, .grace_leave, attribute.overlap_detected. Sample overlap at 1% globally, 100% for escape-hatch tenants.

sophie: action items: maria -> mock overlap UI; tomas -> PR for proxy grace (canary next week); jason -> telemetry + billing spec.

maria: filing follow-up incident ticket with RCA and plan; will link PRs here. Thanks.
